# livekit_sip_dispatch_rule (Resource)

A SIP dispatch rule: which room an inbound call joins, and which agents are dispatched to it. Set exactly one of `direct`, `individual` and `callee`. The API refuses a rule that conflicts with another, such as one for the same trunks, numbers and PIN. Every change is made in place. Settings the provider does not model, such as media codecs, are kept as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "livekit_sip_inbound_trunk" "main" {
  numbers = ["+14155550100"]
}

# Each caller gets a room of their own, with a voice agent dispatched to it.
resource "livekit_sip_dispatch_rule" "support" {
  name      = "support"
  trunk_ids = [livekit_sip_inbound_trunk.main.id]

  individual = {
    room_prefix = "support-"
  }

  agents = [{
    agent_name = "support-agent"
    metadata   = jsonencode({ language = "en" })
  }]

  attributes = {
    queue = "support"
  }
}

# Every caller with the PIN joins one room.
resource "livekit_sip_dispatch_rule" "standup" {
  name      = "standup"
  trunk_ids = [livekit_sip_inbound_trunk.main.id]
  numbers   = ["+14155550100"]

  direct = {
    room_name = "daily-standup"
    pin       = "4321"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `agents` (Attributes List) Agents dispatched to the rooms the rule creates, in the room configuration's `agents`. Not set, the rule dispatches none. Other room configuration fields are kept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))
- `attributes` (Map of String) Attributes the participants the rule creates inherit.
- `callee` (Attributes) Put callers into a room per number called. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--callee))
- `direct` (Attributes) Put every caller into one existing room. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--direct))
- `hide_phone_number` (Boolean) Hide the caller's number from the room. Defaults to `false`.
- `inbound_numbers` (Set of String) Accept only calls from these numbers. Not set, any caller. Numbers are in E.164 format, such as `+14155550100`.
- `individual` (Attributes) Put each caller into a new room of their own. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--individual))
- `krisp_enabled` (Boolean) Apply Krisp noise cancellation to callers. Defaults to `false`.
- `media_encryption` (String) Media encryption (SRTP) for calls. One of `disable`, `allow`, `require`. Defaults to `disable`.
- `metadata` (String) Free-form metadata for the rule; participants the rule creates inherit it. Defaults to `""`.
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the rule. Defaults to `""`.
- `numbers` (Set of String) Accept only calls to these numbers. Not set, any. Numbers are in E.164 format, such as `+14155550100`.
- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`) the dispatch rule belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the dispatch rule is created; a later change of that default does not move it. Changing this argument replaces the dispatch rule.
- `room_preset` (String) Name of a room configuration preset of the project to create rooms with. Defaults to `""`.
- `trunk_ids` (Set of String) Inbound trunks (`ST_...`) and phone numbers (`PN_...`) the rule applies to. Not set, every trunk and number. The API does not check that they exist. To send a `livekit_phone_number`'s calls to this rule, add its `id` here.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Dispatch rule ID (`SDR_...`).

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Required:

- `agent_name` (String) Name the agent registered with.

Optional:

- `metadata` (String) Metadata passed to the agent's job. Defaults to `""`.


<a id="nestedatt--callee"></a>
### Nested Schema for `callee`

Optional:

- `pin` (String, Sensitive) A PIN the caller must enter before joining. The API returns it in clear; it is stored in the state.
- `randomize` (Boolean) Add a random suffix to room names. Defaults to `false`.
- `room_prefix` (String) Prefix of the names of the rooms the rule creates. Defaults to `""`.


<a id="nestedatt--direct"></a>
### Nested Schema for `direct`

Required:

- `room_name` (String) The room callers join.

Optional:

- `pin` (String, Sensitive) A PIN the caller must enter before joining. The API returns it in clear; it is stored in the state.


<a id="nestedatt--individual"></a>
### Nested Schema for `individual`

Optional:

- `no_randomness` (Boolean) Name rooms after the caller only, without a random suffix. Defaults to `false`.
- `pin` (String, Sensitive) A PIN the caller must enter before joining. The API returns it in clear; it is stored in the state.
- `room_prefix` (String) Prefix of the names of the rooms the rule creates. Defaults to `""`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a dispatch rule by "<project_id>/<rule_id>".
terraform import livekit_sip_dispatch_rule.support p_abc123/SDR_abcdef123456
```
